name: io.github.DJeswar/github-issues
title: GitHub Issues (read-only)
description: Read-only access to one GitHub repository's issues: list and search issues, fetch full detail with comments, and enumerate labels and milestones. Ships a fixture backend so it runs with no credentials.

environmentVariables.name: ISSUES_BACKEND
environmentVariables.description: 'fixture' (default) reads a bundled sample corpus and needs no credentials. 'github' reads the live GitHub REST API.

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_REPO
environmentVariables.description: Target repository as 'owner/name'. Required when ISSUES_BACKEND=github.

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional fine-grained personal access token, read-only on Issues. Unauthenticated public-repo reads work at 60 requests/hour; a token raises that to 5000.

environmentVariables.name: SSL_TRUST_STORE
environmentVariables.description: 'certifi' (default) or 'system'. Use 'system' behind a TLS-inspecting corporate proxy, whose internal CA certifi does not carry.

environmentVariables.name: FIXTURE_NOW
environmentVariables.description: Reference 'now' for the fixture backend, so time-relative fields are reproducible.
